SQL as typed (lines 81-86)
------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
select /*+ opt_param('optimizer_index_caching' 40) */ /* mtk_opt_1111t121259668 altered */ c.name, o.status, sum(o.amount) amt
  from mtk_cust c join mtk_orders o on o.cust_id = c.id
 where c.id between :cid and :cid + 50
   and o.status in (select status from mtk_orders where amount > 100)
   and exists (select 1 from mtk_audit a where a.row_id = o.id)
 group by c.name, o.status order by 3 desc

[4] line 896  SQL   (previous statement: line 851)
    SELECT "C"."NAME" "NAME","O"."STATUS" "STATUS",SUM("O"."AMOUNT") "AMT"
    FROM "MTK"."MTK_CUST" "C",
      "MTK"."MTK_ORDERS" "O"
    WHERE "C"."ID">=:B1
      AND "C"."ID"<=:B2+50
      AND "O"."STATUS"=ANY (
        SELECT "MTK_ORDERS"."STATUS" "STATUS"
        FROM "MTK"."MTK_ORDERS" "MTK_ORDERS"
        WHERE "MTK_ORDERS"."AMOUNT">100)
      AND EXISTS (
        SELECT 1 "1"
        FROM "MTK"."MTK_AUDIT" "A"
        WHERE "A"."ROW_ID"="O"."ID")
      AND "O"."CUST_ID"="C"."ID"
    GROUP BY "C"."NAME","O"."STATUS"
    ORDER BY SUM("O"."AMOUNT") DESC

    SELECT "C"."NAME" "NAME","O"."STATUS" "STATUS",SUM("O"."AMOUNT") "AMT"
    FROM "MTK"."MTK_AUDIT" "A",
      "MTK"."MTK_ORDERS" "MTK_ORDERS",
      "MTK"."MTK_CUST" "C",
      "MTK"."MTK_ORDERS" "O"
    WHERE "C"."ID">=:B1
      AND "C"."ID"<=:B2+50
      AND "O"."CUST_ID"="C"."ID"

    SELECT "C"."NAME" "NAME","O"."STATUS" "STATUS",SUM("O"."AMOUNT") "AMT"
    FROM "MTK"."MTK_AUDIT" "A",
      "MTK"."MTK_ORDERS" "MTK_ORDERS",
      "MTK"."MTK_CUST" "C",
      "MTK"."MTK_ORDERS" "O"
    WHERE "C"."ID">=:B1
      AND "C"."ID"<=:B2+50
      AND "O"."CUST_ID"="C"."ID"

      AND "O"."CUST_ID">=:B5
